lung_macrophage_primary.sql: tissue IN ('epithelial cell of lung', 'lower lobe of left lung', 'lung', 'lung epithelium', 'middle lobe of right lung', 'upper lobe of left lung') AND cell_type IN ('TREM2-positive macrophage', 'alveolar macrophage', 'central nervous system macrophage', 'gastrointestinal tract (lamina propria) macrophage', 'inflammatory macrophage', 'kidney resident macrophage', 'lung interstitial macrophage', 'lung macrophage', 'macrophage') AND is_primary_data

lung_macrophage.sql: tissue IN ('epithelial cell of lung', 'lower lobe of left lung', 'lung', 'lung epithelium', 'middle lobe of right lung', 'upper lobe of left lung') AND cell_type IN ('TREM2-positive macrophage', 'alveolar macrophage', 'inflammatory macrophage', 'lung interstitial macrophage', 'lung macrophage', 'macrophage')

false_positive.sql: assay = '10x 3'' v3' AND tissue = 'mesenteric lymph node'

not_in.sql: tissue_general = 'lung' AND cell_type NOT IN ('alveolar macrophage', 'type II pneumocyte')

wmg_count.sql: is_primary_data AND nnz >= 500 AND cell_type_ontology_term_id <> 'unknown' AND tissue_general_ontology_term_id NOT IN ('UBERON:0001017', 'UBERON:0001007', 'UBERON:0002405', 'UBERON:0000990', 'UBERON:0001004', 'UBERON:0001434')
